title: Isaiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 11
description: Ten questions on Isaiah 11: the shoot from the stock of Jesse, the wolf with the lamb, and the highway for the remnant.

questions.text: Out of whose stock will a shoot come?
questions.explanation: The chapter opens, "A shoot will come out of the stock of Jesse, and a branch out of his roots will bear fruit."

questions.text: What will rest on the branch from Jesse's roots?
questions.explanation: The text says, "Yahweh's Spirit will rest on him: the spirit of wisdom and understanding, the spirit of counsel and might, the spirit of knowledge and of the fear of Yahweh."

questions.text: By what will the shoot from the stock of Jesse NOT judge?
questions.explanation: The text says he will not judge by the sight of his eyes, neither decide by the hearing of his ears.

answers.text: By the sight of his eyes

questions.text: What will he do with the breath of his lips?
questions.explanation: He will strike the earth with the rod of his mouth, and with the breath of his lips he will kill the wicked.

questions.text: What will be the belt of his waist?
questions.explanation: The text says, "Righteousness will be the belt of his waist, and faithfulness the belt of his waist."

questions.text: With which animal will the wolf live in that day?
questions.explanation: The text says, "The wolf will live with the lamb, and the leopard will lie down with the young goat."

questions.text: What will the lion eat like the ox?
questions.explanation: The text says, "The lion will eat straw like the ox."

questions.text: Near what will the nursing child play?
questions.explanation: The text says, "The nursing child will play near a cobra's hole, and the weaned child will put his hand on the viper's den."

questions.text: With what will the earth be full, as the waters cover the sea?
questions.explanation: The text says, "the earth will be full of the knowledge of Yahweh, as the waters cover the sea."

questions.text: Into how many streams will Yahweh split the River with his scorching wind?
questions.explanation: The text says Yahweh will wave his hand over the River and will split it into seven streams, and cause men to march over in sandals.
